answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 156770 Country: Bangladesh Title: About the book Nasqsh-e-Sulaimani Question: (1) What is Naqsh-e-Sulaimani (AS)? (2) And what are the numbers which are used in Tawiz? Is it halal or haram? Answer ID: 156770 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 267/217/SD=3/1439) (1) Naqsh-e-Sulaimani is a book of Tawiz . Hakim al-Ummah Hadhrat Maulana Ashraf Ali Thanavi (may Allah have mercy upon him) has forbidden to read it. (Bahishti Zewar, vol. 10, p. 614) (2) It is lawful to write numbers in the tawiz whose meaning is known as it is an understood. (Ahsanul Fatawa, vol. 8, p. 257, Mutafarriqat al-Hazar al-Ibahat, pub. Zakariah, Deoband) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
